## pb-generic (N8N-4.1)
**Trigger:** called by recv-wazuh-alert through Execute Workflow, not waited for, when lib-route-alert chooses it (every route today: the routing fallback, N8N-1.3).
**Inputs:** `{alert: <raw Wazuh alert>, config: <lib-config>, recv_execution_id, route: <lib-route-alert route>}`; without `route`, the default case template.
**Actions taken:** lib-normalize-wazuh-alert -> lib-extract-observables (refanged, validated, merged; internal and documentation IPs tagged range:* and flagged, never dropped) -> lib-thehive-upsert-alert (one TheHive alert per Wazuh alert, dedup by sourceRef) -> ENRICHMENT STUB (no-op until lib-enrich-observable, N8N-2.4, which reads the range flag) -> lib-thehive-writeback (comment with this execution id and the route: id, matched by, playbook, case template, fallback, proposed matches). Malformed input and TheHive failures are parked by lib-error.
**Systems changed:** TheHive only (alert and comment).
**Approval:** not needed (no system changes).
**Owner:** n8n.
Result of the execution: `outcome` = created / duplicate / parked / skipped (`skipped: TheHive not configured` when lib-config says TheHive isn't deployed here: no park, no writeback). Error workflow: recv-n8n-error.
